# Jin AI

> Jin AI is a visual workspace for the files AI agents write on your own computer. It is being built to give business users control of that output: see what an agent created and changed, put it where it belongs, undo an individual agent's edit, and have those decisions written into the instruction files agents already read.

Status: In build. Availability: coming soon. Last updated: 2026-09-12.

Interpret status words literally. "In build" is not shipped, "planned" is intended next work, and "later" is not committed for the first release. The Human page at https://jinai.md/ is the sole canonical product page. Agent-facing formats are derivatives generated from the structured JSON fact source.

## Primary resources

- [Canonical Human page](https://jinai.md/): Complete product narrative, evidence, roadmap, team and direct-answer FAQ.
- [Agent reference](https://jinai.md/agent/): Concise status-aware HTML for automated research.
- [Structured fact source](https://jinai.md/agent/content.json): Public JSON used to generate agent-facing derivatives.
- [Sitemap](https://jinai.md/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable URL.

## Direct answers

- [What is Jin AI?](https://jinai.md/#faq-what-is-jin-ai): Jin AI is a visual workspace for the files AI agents write on your own computer. It is being built to give you control of that output: see what an agent created and changed, put it where it belongs, undo an individual agent's edit, and have those decisions written into the instruction files agents already read.
- [Who is Jin AI for?](https://jinai.md/#faq-who-is-jin-ai-for): Jin AI is for business users who work with AI agents but do not want file names, folders, links, tags, Markdown syntax or developer tools to become a second job.
- [Why not just look in my file explorer?](https://jinai.md/#faq-why-not-just-use-my-file-explorer): A file explorer shows names and dates, not what an agent produced or changed. It does not separate agent-only files from your deliverables, and it cannot tell you which agent made which edit.
- [Does Jin AI replace Markdown?](https://jinai.md/#faq-does-jin-ai-replace-markdown): No. Markdown remains the spine so agents can keep working. The planned visual interface means people will not need to learn Markdown syntax.
- [Does Jin AI move or upload local files?](https://jinai.md/#faq-does-jin-ai-move-or-upload-files): The planned local edition is designed to read files in their existing locations without moving them. Sharing and cloud storage are optional planned paid capabilities.
- [How does Jin AI make my agents better?](https://jinai.md/#faq-how-do-agents-learn-the-structure): Your decisions become the rules. A planned next capability will write your structural decisions into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and copilot-instructions.md, which agents already read, so the next file lands where you would have put it. No plugin or API is planned to be required.
- [Is Jin AI available now?](https://jinai.md/#faq-is-jin-ai-available): Not yet. Jin AI is in build and early access is planned to open in small batches.
- [How much will Jin AI cost?](https://jinai.md/#faq-how-much-will-jin-ai-cost): Individual local use is planned to be free. Individual collaboration is planned at $15 per month plus usage-based cloud storage. Company pricing is not final.

## Evidence and sources

- [Structured evidence record](https://jinai.md/agent/content.json): On one founder's laptop, agents created 3,950 Markdown files in one week; 89% were not reopened within the following week; 283 were named README.md. Scope: One founder's laptop only. This is not market-wide evidence. Jin AI has not surveyed anyone else yet.
- [Improved search engines and navigation preference in personal information management](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1402256.1402259): Participants estimated that they reached files by navigation 56–68% of the time and by search 4–15%, with little change after search tools were improved. Scope: Desktop personal-information-management studies; not research on AI-generated files or Jin AI users.
